assessments.reasoning: The overview characterizes Pd as a graphical programming environment and illustrates a computational patch whose connection routes a number-box output to a print-box input. These statements and the scoped patch definition support the graphical language expressed inside Pd.

challenge.method: Compare the described patch with the publisher release specimen and separate mentions of MAX, libpd and graphical scores. Verify that the official tag points to the chapter commit.
challenge.results: The cited graph composes executable behavior. Similarity to MAX is not equivalence, libpd is an embedding example, and the score section is an application using data structures. The .pd file illustrates a serialized patch without making all .pd files or the tool itself identical to the language.

limitations: The documented patching language is separately scoped. The review supplies no language equivalence, file encoding specification or behavior of any other release.
